cases.invariant: A broker-visible exact client order ID resolves UNKNOWN_SUBMIT without retry or duplicate submission.
An open broker order does not confirm a requested cancel; state stays CANCEL_REQUESTED_UNCONFIRMED and submission remains blocked.
A late execution remains recorded as a fill with discrepancy and operator alert; it is not erased or treated as canceled.
Repeating the same callback is idempotent and the execution is counted once.
A changed previously recorded execution appends a compensating event, preserves its original, and blocks pending operator resolution.
A previously recorded execution absent from a complete covering execution window appends a compensating event, preserves its original, and blocks pending operator resolution.
A port-level BrokerOutcomeUnknown produces UNKNOWN and keeps the account blocked; partial data cannot reconcile.
Identity from BrokerPortV1.venue must match caller expectation; mismatch is UNKNOWN and blocks submission.
An unmatched broker order is BROKER_ONLY and is never attached by instrument or quantity alone; divergence blocks submission.
Injected LOCAL_OBSERVED_AT older than the exact freshness bound yields UNKNOWN and blocks submission.
An observation exactly at the freshness limit is accepted; one nanosecond older is UNKNOWN and blocking.
AccountViewV1 positions must exactly match OMS-derived positions; mismatch is CONFLICT and blocks submission.
The same ledger and complete account view after restart produce the same deterministic result; startup submits zero orders.
Resolution requires explicit operator actor, reason, and evidence; it is audited and does not create a submit, cancel, or offset order.
Balances and session remain UNVERIFIED and non-blocking in PAPER or DEMO, explicitly reflected in the result.
Balances and session remain UNVERIFIED and blocking in LIVE.
A close request with no broker ID and no fill leaves the position open/unknown; it cannot silently become flat.
Startup/reconnect reconciliation is read-only and emits or submits zero orders.
A result for a port identity mismatch is keyed to the caller's expected account, never the unexpected account.
An execution from another venue or conflicting native/client order owners cannot be counted as a local match.
A PARTIALLY_FILLED state without reconciled execution evidence remains discrepant and blocks submission.
A working-order observation missing its venue-native ID cannot confirm a native-ID-bound OMS order.
An order referring to a parent absent from the ledger yields UNKNOWN, blocks submission, and reports LOCAL_LINEAGE_INVALID.
The caller cannot extend the approved freshness bound by supplying a larger max_age_ns; an observation beyond 300 seconds remains stale.
